question: You are the project manager on a publicly funded project with a disadvantaged business enterprise (DBE) goal of 5%. Your cousin owns a DBE-certified plumbing company and is the low bidder. Do you recommend the contract be awarded? A. No, it is a conflict of interest. B. No, the decision should be made by your superior. C. Yes, there is no conflict of interest because there is no financial benefit to you. D. Yes, as long as you disclose the family relationship.
